sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为无名女尸（Jane Doe）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案陈列室”（Casefile Presents）推出的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: The 7th of May 2005 began as a typical run-of-the-mill day for Shirley Withers.
sentences.zh: 2005年5月7日，对雪莉·威瑟斯（Shirley Withers）来说，本该是平凡无奇的一天。

sentences.en: She worked the full day in her fashion boutique, and once the shop had closed,
sentences.zh: 她在自己的时装精品店工作了一整天，打烊之后，

sentences.en: she bought a take-out meal and then headed to a boyfriend's house in Caulfield in Melbourne, Australia.
sentences.zh: 她买了一份外卖，然后前往位于澳大利亚墨尔本考菲尔德（Caulfield）的男友家。

sentences.en: But what she found when she arrived there about 7pm was anything but run-of-the-mill.
sentences.zh: 但当她在晚上7点左右到达那里时，发现的情况却绝非寻常。

sentences.en: Peter Shellard was a 56-year-old self-made millionaire.
sentences.zh: 彼得·谢拉德（Peter Shellard）是一位56岁的白手起家的百万富翁。

sentences.en: He lived in a luxury North Caulfield mansion worth about $6 million at the time.
sentences.zh: 他住在北考菲尔德的一栋豪华豪宅里，当时价值约600万美元。

sentences.en: He was the type of person that everybody had a story about.
sentences.zh: 他是那种每个人都能讲出一段关于他故事的人。

sentences.en: He was described as a bit of an oddball, a little bit out there.
sentences.zh: 人们形容他有点古怪，思想有些异于常人。

sentences.en: Many referred to him as the eccentric millionaire.
sentences.zh: 许多人称他为“古怪的百万富翁”。

sentences.en: And he lived up to that tag when he appeared on the Today Tonight TV show and outlined his plans to purchase the entire Rolls-Royce factory, worth about $16 billion.
sentences.zh: 当他出现在《今日今夜》（Today Tonight）电视节目中，并阐述他计划购买价值约160亿美元的整个劳斯莱斯工厂时，他确实不负这个称号。

sentences.en: He said in that interview,
sentences.zh: 他在那次采访中说道，

sentences.en: Well, I probably am a bit mad, but it's nice to be a bit mad, isn't it?
sentences.zh: “好吧，我可能确实有点疯狂，但有点疯狂也挺好的，不是吗？”

sentences.en: He made this fortune in real estate, and then he bought into a successful high-end car dealership, specialising in BMWs, Jaguars, and his favourite, Rolls-Royce.
sentences.zh: 他的财富是通过房地产积累的，后来他又买下了一家高端汽车经销店的股份，专门经营宝马、捷豹，以及他最喜欢的劳斯莱斯。

sentences.en: He ended up being the director of several companies and would go on to own numerous residential and commercial properties.
sentences.zh: 最终，他成为了多家公司的董事，并陆续拥有了众多住宅和商业房产。

sentences.en: At the time of his death, his estate was estimated to be worth around $15 million.
sentences.zh: 在他去世时，其遗产估计价值约1500万美元。

sentences.en: Not only was Peter a successful businessman, he was known to be a ruthless businessman.
sentences.zh: 彼得不仅是一位成功的商人，还以冷酷无情著称。

sentences.en: He wasn't the type of person you would want to get on the wrong side of.
sentences.zh: 他可不是那种你想去招惹的人。

sentences.en: He never resorted to violence.
sentences.zh: 他从不诉诸暴力。

sentences.en: His method of battle was to try and financially cripple people.
sentences.zh: 他交锋的方式是试图在经济上摧毁别人。

sentences.en: He would file lawsuits at the drop of a hat.
sentences.zh: 他动不动就提起诉讼。

sentences.en: If there was a problem, Peter was suing.
sentences.zh: 只要有问题，彼得就会把对方告上法庭。

sentences.en: In the year 2000, Peter, aged 51 at the time, met Shirley Withers, who was 33 years old.
sentences.zh: 2000年，当时51岁的彼得遇到了33岁的雪莉·威瑟斯。

sentences.en: Shirley isn't the type of woman you picture a multi-millionaire property developer and luxury car dealer going for.
sentences.zh: 雪莉并不是那种你想象中身家数百万的房地产开发商兼豪车经销商会看上的女性。

sentences.en: She wasn't your glamour type, so to speak.
sentences.zh: 可以说，她并不是那种光鲜亮丽的类型。

sentences.en: Regardless, Peter was smitten when he first met Shirley.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，彼得在第一次见到雪莉时就深深地迷恋上了她。

sentences.en: Peter had previously been married twice and had three daughters.
sentences.zh: 彼得此前曾结过两次婚，育有三个女儿。

sentences.en: Shirley herself had been divorced once and had two sons.
sentences.zh: 雪莉自己也离过一次婚，有两个儿子。

sentences.en: Their relationship blossomed and moved quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们的关系迅速升温，如胶似漆。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, Shirley found herself in a completely new lifestyle, filled with every luxury she could imagine.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，雪莉发现自己置身于一种全新的人生活方式中，身边充斥着她能想象到的各种奢华。

sentences.en: Peter was smitten, so whatever Shirley wanted, she got.
sentences.zh: 彼得为之倾倒，所以只要雪莉想要什么，就能得到什么。

sentences.en: Peter bought her an upmarket fashion boutique in the Melbourne suburb of Brighton.
sentences.zh: 彼得在墨尔本的布莱顿（Brighton）郊区给她买了一家高档时装精品店。

sentences.en: Shirley ran the business, but Peter financed everything.
sentences.zh: 雪莉经营着这家店，但所有的资金都由彼得提供。

sentences.en: And it wasn't long before Peter had another surprise for Shirley.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，彼得又给雪莉准备了另一个惊喜。

sentences.en: A brand new house.
sentences.zh: 一栋崭新的房子。

sentences.en: Being divorced twice, Peter was in no hurry to move in together, so he stayed living in his Caulfield mansion.
sentences.zh: 由于有过两次离婚经历，彼得并不急于同居，因此他继续住在自己的考菲尔德豪宅里。

sentences.en: And Shirley could have her own house to live in.
sentences.zh: 而雪莉可以拥有属于自己的房子居住。

sentences.en: Shirley, of course, had a key for Peter's mansion and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 当然，雪莉有彼得豪宅的钥匙，反之亦然。

sentences.en: Shirley was a bookkeeper, so Peter decided to make use of her skills.
sentences.zh: 雪莉是一名簿记员，于是彼得决定利用她的专长。

sentences.en: He put her in charge of the books at his luxury car dealership.
sentences.zh: 他让她负责他豪华汽车经销店的账目。

sentences.en: On the 7th of May 2005, Shirley Withers spent the full day working in her fashion boutique in Brighton.
sentences.zh: 2005年5月7日，雪莉·威瑟斯在布莱顿的时装精品店工作了一整天。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, she finished up all the bookwork, bought a takeout meal, and then headed to Peter's mansion in Caulfield.
sentences.zh: 一天结束时，她做完了所有的账目工作，买了一份外卖，然后前往彼得位于考菲尔德的豪宅。

sentences.en: When she walked inside, she found Peter dead on the floor.
sentences.zh: 当她走进去时，发现彼得倒在地上，已经没有了生命体征。

sentences.en: He had been tied up with dog leashes, electrical cords and ropes.
sentences.zh: 他被狗链、电线和绳索捆绑着。

sentences.en: His mouth had been gagged shut.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴被塞住并封死。

sentences.en: But that's when Shirley made that frantic triple-O call.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，雪莉拨通了那个惊慌失措的紧急求救电话。

sentences.en: Detectives arrived soon after, and they were confronted with one of the most bizarre crime scenes they had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 侦探们不久后抵达现场，展现在他们眼前的是他们见过最离奇的犯罪现场之一。

sentences.en: They looked more like a movie set than real life.
sentences.zh: 这里看起来更像是一个电影片场，而不是现实生活。

sentences.en: It's here that the secret world of Peter Shellard started to make a very public appearance.
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，彼得·谢拉德的秘密世界开始公诸于众。

sentences.en: There was a great deal of bondage equipment at the scene.
sentences.zh: 现场有大量的捆绑调教（束缚）设备。

sentences.en: There were leather masks, leather outfits, whips, dog leads, chains, harnesses, belts and other equipment.
sentences.zh: 有皮面具、皮质服装、皮鞭、狗链、铁链、背带、皮带和其他器材。

sentences.en: The initial impression of the crime scene was that it appeared to be a sexual encounter that had gone horribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 对犯罪现场的最初印象是，这似乎是一场出了严重差错的性爱遭遇。

sentences.en: Peter had bruising all around his body as well as facial injuries.
sentences.zh: 彼得全身都有瘀伤，面部也受伤了。

sentences.en: Had somebody gone too far?
sentences.zh: 难道是有人玩得太过了吗？

sentences.en: A thorough examination of the crime scene was conducted, and the police were in luck.
sentences.zh: 警方对犯罪现场进行了彻底的勘查，运气也随之降临。

sentences.en: A bloody fingerprint was found on Peter's home phone, and a cigarette butt was found in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在彼得的家用电话上发现了一个带血的指纹，厨房里还有一个烟头。

sentences.en: Did these belong to Peter?
sentences.zh: 这些是彼得的吗？

sentences.en: Or were they turning out to be vital clues?
sentences.zh: 还是说它们将成为至关重要的线索？

sentences.en: Unfortunately, there was no way of knowing straight away.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，当时无法立刻知晓。

sentences.en: Detectives would have to wait until the results came back from the lab, which could take a little while.
sentences.zh: 侦探们不得不等待实验室的检测结果，这可能需要一段时间。

sentences.en: In the meantime, they had to get to work to find out what exactly happened to Peter.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他们必须着手查明彼得究竟遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: The first obvious person to question was Shirley Withers, Peter's girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 第一个需要盘问的显眼人物自然是彼得的女友雪莉·威瑟斯。

sentences.en: She had found Peter dead and made the frantic emergency telephone call.
sentences.zh: 正是她发现了倒地的彼得并拨打了惊慌失措的紧急电话。

sentences.en: They asked her about Peter's interest in bondage, but she was unable to offer them too much information.
sentences.zh: 他们向她询问了彼得对捆绑调教的兴趣，但她无法提供太多信息。

sentences.en: Peter had asked her to participate in bondage previously, but she declined.
sentences.zh: 彼得以前曾要求她参与捆绑调教，但被她拒绝了。

sentences.en: Shirley told detectives Peter respected her decision and didn't pursue it any further with her.
sentences.zh: 雪莉告诉侦探，彼得尊重她的决定，此后没有再对她提起过此事。

sentences.en: She was completely oblivious to any acts of bondage Peter was participating in.
sentences.zh: 对于彼得正在参与的任何捆绑调教活动，她完全一无所知。

sentences.en: Detectives discovered that Shirley stood to gain nothing out of Peter's death.
sentences.zh: 侦探们发现，雪莉从彼得的死中得不到任何好处。

sentences.en: With the exception of $1 each he left to each of his two ex-wives, Peter's entire estate was left to his daughters.
sentences.zh: 除了留给两位前妻每人1美元外，彼得的全部遗产都留给了他的女儿们。

sentences.en: This removed a very big, very common motive for murder.
sentences.zh: 这就排除了一个非常重大、非常普遍的谋杀动机。

sentences.en: As far as detectives could tell, Shirley had no other motive to harm him.
sentences.zh: 就侦探所能了解到的情况而言，雪莉没有其他伤害他的动机。

sentences.en: She appeared shocked and heartbroken, and her actions didn't raise suspicion at all.
sentences.zh: 她看起来震惊且心碎，她的举动完全没有引起怀疑。

sentences.en: Detectives started to look elsewhere for motive and opportunity.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始从其他地方寻找动机和作案机会。

sentences.en: Despite what the crime scene looked like, they weren't completely sold on the theory that Peter had died as a result of a bondage session gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 尽管犯罪现场呈现出那种景象，但他们并不完全相信彼得是因为一次失控的捆绑调教而丧命的理论。

sentences.en: They were more than open to the possibility that the crime scene had been staged to make it look that way.
sentences.zh: 他们完全持开放态度，认为犯罪现场可能是被人刻意布置成那样的。

sentences.en: They started diving into Peter's past business relationships, and looking at the long list of people Peter had filed lawsuits againSt.
sentences.zh: 他们开始深入调查彼得过去的商业关系，并查看了彼得曾起诉过的大长串人员名单。

sentences.en: Despite the thinking being there was a long list of people with a reason to harm Peter,
sentences.zh: 尽管人们认为有长长的一串人有理由伤害彼得，

sentences.en: detectives really didn't find anything significant.
sentences.zh: 但侦探们实际上并没有发现任何重大线索。

sentences.en: No obvious suspects jumped out at them.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个明显的嫌疑人跃入他们的脑海。

sentences.en: This led detectives to go back to the bondage gone wrong theory.
sentences.zh: 这促使侦探们重新回到了“捆绑调教失控”的理论上来。

sentences.en: And if this is what happened, they needed to establish who Peter's partner, or partners, were on the night of his death.
sentences.zh: 如果事情确实如此，他们就需要查明在彼得遇害当晚，他的伴侣或伴侣们究竟是谁。

sentences.en: Despite his partner Shirley saying that Peter hadn't pursued his interest in bondage any further with her,
sentences.zh: 尽管他的伴侣雪莉曾说过彼得没有再对她提起过对捆绑调教的兴趣，

sentences.en: detectives soon found that it hadn't stopped Peter pursuing his interest in bondage elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 但侦探们很快发现，这并没有阻止彼得在其他地方继续追求他对捆绑调教的爱好。

sentences.en: He was very much into it.
sentences.zh: 他对此非常热衷。

sentences.en: He had paid several visits to the Hellfire Club in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 他曾多次光顾墨尔本的地狱火俱乐部（Hellfire Club）。

sentences.en: At the Hellfire Club, you could do things such as get tied up, get whipped, have hot wax poured over you, and so on.
sentences.zh: 在地狱火俱乐部里，你可以做诸如被捆绑、挨鞭子、被滴热蜡之类的事情。

sentences.en: Alternatively, you could do these things to somebody else if you so desired.
sentences.zh: 或者，如果你愿意，你也可以对别人做这些事。

sentences.en: This was useful information, but again, detectives still couldn't come up with any suspects from the bondage angle.
sentences.zh: 这些是有用的信息，但同样，侦探们依然无法从捆绑调教的角度锁定任何嫌疑人。

sentences.en: A few days later, the autopsy result came back, and it would have a major impact on the investigation.
sentences.zh: 几天后，尸检结果出来了，它对案件的调查产生了重大影响。

sentences.en: It was found that Peter suffered repeated blunt force trauma to the head, resulting in a fractured skull.
sentences.zh: 经查，彼得头部遭受了多次钝器打击，导致头骨骨折。

sentences.en: And not only that, Peter's body had been pumped full of heroin.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，彼得体内被注入了大量海洛因。

sentences.en: Peter wasn't a user of heroin.
sentences.zh: 彼得并不是海洛因吸食者。

sentences.en: In fact, he wasn't a user of drugs at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他根本不吸毒。

sentences.en: He was known to be quite anti-drugs.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，他非常反感毒品。

sentences.en: The theory that he may have died as a result of an overzealous bondage session was shot out of the water.
sentences.zh: 他可能死于过度热情的捆绑调教这一理论彻底破灭了。

sentences.en: It was clear Peter had been deliberately beaten and then given a hot shot.
sentences.zh: 很明显，彼得先是被蓄意殴打，然后被注射了一剂致命毒品（hot shot）。

sentences.en: A hit of heroin designed to kill.
sentences.zh: 一剂旨在夺命的海洛因。

sentences.en: There was near no doubt.
sentences.zh: 几乎毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Somebody had intended to kill Peter.
sentences.zh: 有人存心置彼得于死地。

sentences.en: And it wasn't long after this that detectives got the break in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，侦探们在调查中取得了突破。

sentences.en: They had matched the bloody fingerprint, and it didn't belong to Peter.
sentences.zh: 他们比对出了那个带血的指纹，它不属于彼得。

sentences.en: The fingerprint matched a girl by the name of Sophia Stupas.
sentences.zh: 该指纹与一名叫索菲娅·斯图帕斯（Sophia Stupas）的女子相符。

sentences.en: Not only that, her DNA was found on the cigarette that had been left in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，在厨房遗留的烟头上也发现了她的DNA。

sentences.en: Sophia was known to police.
sentences.zh: 警方认识索菲娅。

sentences.en: So was her boyfriend, Stanley.
sentences.zh: 她的男友斯坦利（Stanley）也是如此。

sentences.en: They were small-time petty criminals and known drug addicts.
sentences.zh: 他们都是些小偷小摸的微罪惯犯，也是众所周知的瘾君子。

sentences.en: They were both particularly fond of heroin.
sentences.zh: 两人都对海洛因情有独钟。

sentences.en: But despite their long criminal records, neither was known for violence.
sentences.zh: 但尽管他们有着长长的犯罪记录，两人却都不是以暴力闻名。

sentences.en: It was all drugs and property theft type stuff to support their drug habit.
sentences.zh: 全都是毒品和盗窃财物之类的事情，以支撑他们的毒瘾。

sentences.en: But what was interesting for police was that Sophia had a history in bondage.
sentences.zh: 但对警方而言有趣的是，索菲娅有涉及捆绑调教的黑历史。

sentences.en: Police knew this after bondage equipment was found at her place during a police raid that had been conducted previously, for an unrelated matter.
sentences.zh: 警方之所以知道这一点，是因为此前由于一起不相关的案件对她住所进行搜查时，警方在她那里发现了捆绑调教器材。

sentences.en: Sophia had definitely been at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 索菲娅绝对去过犯罪现场。

sentences.en: And wherever Sophia went, Stanley was usually there as well.
sentences.zh: 而且索菲娅去哪儿，斯坦利通常也会跟到哪儿。

sentences.en: Their involvement could explain both the bondage angle and the heroin angle.
sentences.zh: 他们的涉案可以同时解释捆绑调教的角度和海洛因的角度。

sentences.en: Police now had their prime suspects.
sentences.zh: 警方现在有了他们的主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: But as detectives were getting ready to make their move on Sophia and Stanley,
sentences.zh: 但正当侦探们准备对索菲娅和斯坦利采取行动时，

sentences.en: the case took an unexpected twiSt.
sentences.zh: 案件发生了意想不到的转折。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案节目继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: A telephone call had just been intercepted by police.
sentences.zh: 警方刚刚截获了一通电话。

sentences.en: And this telephone call had massive significance for the murder investigation.
sentences.zh: 这通电话对谋杀案的调查具有极其重大的意义。

sentences.en: A contract had just been put out for the lives of Sophia and Stanley.
sentences.zh: 有人刚刚买凶要取索菲娅和斯坦利的性命。

sentences.en: Whilst they both had long criminal records, they were small-time, low-level drug addicts, petty criminals.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们俩都有长长的犯罪记录，但也只是小打小闹、底层的瘾君子和小偷小摸。

sentences.en: They didn't mix in the circles where people put hits out on each other.
sentences.zh: 他们并不在那种会花钱买凶杀人的圈子里混。

sentences.en: But it turns out it wasn't fellow criminals that wanted them dead.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，想要他们死的人并不是同案犯。

sentences.en: The hit was ordered by Shirley Withers.
sentences.zh: 这个买凶杀人的命令是雪莉·威瑟斯下达的。

sentences.en: This raised some very interesting questions.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一些非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: How the hell did Shirley Withers know Sophia and Stanley were involved in Peter's death?
sentences.zh: 雪莉·威瑟斯到底是怎么知道索菲娅和斯坦利参与了彼得的死的？

sentences.en: Had somebody leaked the information to her?
sentences.zh: 是有人把消息泄露给她了吗？

sentences.en: Or did Shirley know more than she was letting on?
sentences.zh: 还是说雪莉知道的内情比她表现出来的要多？

sentences.en: Either way, detectives had to find out.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，侦探们必须查明真相。

sentences.en: So they sent in Victor the hitman.
sentences.zh: 于是他们派出了杀手维克托（Victor）。

sentences.en: He was of course not a real hitman.
sentences.zh: 他当然不是真正的杀手。

sentences.en: He was an undercover police officer.
sentences.zh: 他是一名卧底警察。

sentences.en: Victor tells Shirley that he can do the job for $10,000.
sentences.zh: 维克托告诉雪莉，他可以以1万美元的价格搞定这件事。

sentences.en: But he needs photos of them and their addresses.
sentences.zh: 但他需要他们的照片和住址。

sentences.en: Shirley gave Victor this information, handed over photos and a cash deposit.
sentences.zh: 雪莉把这些信息给了维克托，并交出了照片和现金定金。

sentences.en: She said to Victor, They are the ones that killed my Peter and they have to pay for what they've done.
sentences.zh: 她对维克托说：“他们就是杀害我的彼得的人，他们必须为自己做过的事付出代价。”

sentences.en: I want blood.
sentences.zh: “我要血债血偿。”

sentences.en: Detectives quickly made their move on Sophia and Stanley.
sentences.zh: 侦探们迅速对索菲娅和斯坦利采取了行动。

sentences.en: Although Shirley had just hired a police officer to kill them, they weren't too sure if maybe she'd hired a second person as well.
sentences.zh: 尽管雪莉刚刚雇了一名警察去杀他们，但他们不太确定她是否还雇了第二个人。

sentences.en: So they arrested them and took them back to the police station to find out exactly what they knew.
sentences.zh: 因此他们将两人逮捕并带回警察局，以彻底查清他们到底知道些什么。

sentences.en: During the initial stages of questioning, both of them deny having any knowledge about Peter's death.
sentences.zh: 在最初的讯问阶段，两人都否认知道任何关于彼得之死的事情。

sentences.en: They put up the wall of silence.
sentences.zh: 他们筑起了沉默的高墙。

sentences.en: But that soon changed when police told them Shirley had just put a hit out on them.
sentences.zh: 但当警方告诉他们雪莉刚刚花钱买凶要取他们性命时，情况很快就变了。

sentences.en: When they learnt that, they couldn't talk quick enough.
sentences.zh: 一听到这个消息，他们竹筒倒豆子似的全招了。

sentences.en: They admitted to police that they were there the night that Peter died and they know what happened to him.
sentences.zh: 他们向警方承认，彼得去世当晚他们在现场，并且知道他遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: But according to them, they weren't there alone.
sentences.zh: 但据他们所说，他们并非孤身一人。

sentences.en: They both named a third person who was there with them.
sentences.zh: 两人说出了当时与他们同行的第三个人的名字。

sentences.en: Detective started to take a much closer look at Shirley Withers.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始对雪莉·威瑟斯展开更深入的调查。

sentences.en: She was born in India before migrating to Australia.
sentences.zh: 她出生于印度，后来移民到澳大利亚。

sentences.en: She suffered abuse at just nine years of age and this led her to develop post-traumatic stress disorder.
sentences.zh: 她在年仅九岁时遭受虐待，这导致她患上了创伤后应激障碍。

sentences.en: After the birth of her second son, she was in and out of hospital for over a year, suffering severe post-natal depression.
sentences.zh: 生下第二个儿子后，她因患严重的产后抑郁症，一年多里频繁进出医院。

sentences.en: And she ended up making three suicide attempts.
sentences.zh: 她最终甚至尝试过三次自杀。

sentences.en: Detectives started going through the books of Shirley's high-end fashion boutique.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始仔细查阅雪莉的高端时装精品店的账目。

sentences.en: From the outside looking in, everything seemed to suggest the shop was successful and doing quite well.
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，一切迹象都表明这家店很成功，生意相当不错。

sentences.en: But a closer look at the finances showed that the business was actually going backwards and was in significant debt.
sentences.zh: 但深入查看财务状况后发现，这家店实际上一直在走下坡路，并且负债累累。

sentences.en: The business owed close to $300,000.
sentences.zh: 这家店欠下了近30万美元的债务。

sentences.en: The truth was, Shirley had no idea how to run a business.
sentences.zh: 事实是，雪莉根本不知道该怎么经营生意。

sentences.en: She kept ordering high-end stock, despite not being able to sell the stock she currently had on hand.
sentences.zh: 她不断订购高端货品，尽管她根本卖不掉手头现有的库存。

sentences.en: But it didn't worry her.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有让她担忧。

sentences.en: She had Peter's large bank account to steal from.
sentences.zh: 她有彼得的巨额银行账户可以偷钱。

sentences.en: As detectives dug further, they found that Shirley had been stealing from Peter to keep her business afloat
sentences.zh: 随着侦探们的深入挖掘，他们发现雪莉一直在偷彼得的钱来维持店铺运营

sentences.en: and to allow her to keep living the life of luxury she'd become accustomed to.
sentences.zh: 并让她得以继续过着她已经习以为常的奢侈生活。

sentences.en: She started writing checks to herself using Peter's bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 她开始利用彼得的银行账户给自己开支票。

sentences.en: In total, she stole around $900,000 from him.
sentences.zh: 她总共从他那里偷了大约90万美元。

sentences.en: A few weeks before his death,
sentences.zh: 在他死前几周，

sentences.en: Peter started to catch on to what Shirley had been doing.
sentences.zh: 彼得开始察觉到雪莉一直在做的事。

sentences.en: He called his accountant to check his books.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给会计查账。

sentences.en: His accountant told him there was more than enough evidence for Shirley to be charged.
sentences.zh: 他的会计告诉他，有充足的证据可以起诉雪莉。

sentences.en: Peter was furious.
sentences.zh: 彼得勃然大怒。

sentences.en: He immediately froze Shirley out of all his accounts.
sentences.zh: 他立即切断了雪莉对所有账户的使用权限。

sentences.en: Shirley's life of luxury had just come to an abrupt halt.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的奢侈生活就这样戛然而止。

sentences.en: Not only that,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，

sentences.en: Peter put Shirley's house on the market.
sentences.zh: 彼得把雪莉的房子挂牌出售了。

sentences.en: This stung Shirley and she started to formulate a plan to stop Peter from cutting her off.
sentences.zh: 这刺痛了雪莉，她开始盘算着制定一个计划，阻止彼得断她的财路。

sentences.en: She befriended Stanley and Sophia.
sentences.zh: 她结识了斯坦利和索菲亚。

sentences.en: They came from a world far away from Shirley's upmarket lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 他们来自一个远离雪莉上流生活方式的世界。

sentences.en: Shirley essentially groomed them for the job she had planned.
sentences.zh: 雪莉基本上是在为她计划好的工作对他们进行培植和拉拢。

sentences.en: She gave them thousands of dollars in cash in order to buy their friendship and truSt.
sentences.zh: 她给他们数千美元现金，以此换取他们的友谊和信任。

sentences.en: She also won them over with stories detailing how Peter forced her to participate in bondage sessions.
sentences.zh: 她还向他们讲述了彼得如何强迫她参与性虐待的种种故事，以此博取他们的同情。

sentences.en: She said that he tied her up and abused her.
sentences.zh: 她说他把她绑起来并虐待她。

sentences.en: Stanley and Sophia latched on.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利和索菲亚上钩了。

sentences.en: Shirley was throwing money at them and they saw her as an easy target.
sentences.zh: 雪莉向他们砸钱，在他们眼里她成了一个轻易可以下手的目标。

sentences.en: They would do whatever she wanted.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意为她做任何事。

sentences.en: Stanley and Sophia told police everything in their interviews.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利和索菲亚在审讯中向警方全盘托出。

sentences.en: It became clear to them that Shirley had set them up and had planned all along for them to take the rap for Peter's murder.
sentences.zh: 他们逐渐明白，雪莉设局陷害了他们，并且从一开始就打算让他们为彼得的谋杀顶罪。

sentences.en: They both said they were of the belief that they were just going to rough Peter up for cutting off Shirley's money supply and force him to sign some documents for her.
sentences.zh: 他们都表示，他们当时以为只是去教训一下切断雪莉资金来源的彼得，并强迫他为她签署一些文件。

sentences.en: This included him signing the house she lived in over to her so he couldn't sell it.
sentences.zh: 这包括把她住的房子过户到她名下，这样他就无法将其出售。

sentences.en: On the night of May 6th 2005,
sentences.zh: 2005年5月6日夜晚，

sentences.en: Shirley picked up Stanley and Sophia and drove over to Peter's house.
sentences.zh: 雪莉接上斯坦利和索菲亚，开车来到彼得家。

sentences.en: Shirley still had a key to his place so they got in easily.
sentences.zh: 雪莉手里还有他家的钥匙，所以他们轻而易举地进去了。

sentences.en: They made their way to Peter's bedroom where he was found asleep.
sentences.zh: 他们摸黑来到彼得的卧室，发现他正在睡觉。

sentences.en: They immediately jumped on him and started the attack.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻扑上去发动袭击。

sentences.en: During the initial struggle,
sentences.zh: 在最初的搏斗中，

sentences.en: Peter was able to bite Sophia's finger which is what would cause the bloody fingerprint to be left later.
sentences.zh: 彼得咬了索菲亚的手指，这正是后来留下带血指纹的原因。

sentences.en: Sophia responded by belting him over the head.
sentences.zh: 索菲亚随即猛击他的头部作为回应。

sentences.en: Peter was knocked unconscious but he wasn't dead.
sentences.zh: 彼得被打得失去知觉，但他还没死。

sentences.en: They dragged him out of his bed down to the floor and tied him up.
sentences.zh: 他们把他从床上拖到地板上并把他绑起来。

sentences.en: Shirley then injected Peter with heroin.
sentences.zh: 随后雪莉给彼得注射了海洛因。

sentences.en: They left the house but then Shirley returned the next day to give Peter another shot of heroin just to make sure he wouldn't wake up.
sentences.zh: 他们离开了房子，但第二天雪莉又返回给彼得注射了另一剂海洛因，以确保他不会醒来。

sentences.en: Yeah, she pretty much wanted to just finish him off.
sentences.zh: 是的，她基本上就是想彻底了结他。

sentences.en: She wanted to finish him off, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想她就是想彻底了结他。

sentences.en: Finish him off?
sentences.zh: 彻底了结他？

sentences.en: Her husband.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫。

sentences.en: Shirley then set the crime scene up to make it look as though
sentences.zh: 接着，雪莉伪造了犯罪现场，让人以为

sentences.en: Peter had been engaging in a bondage act.
sentences.zh: 彼得是在进行性虐待活动。

sentences.en: She went to work for the day then returned that night
sentences.zh: 她去工作了一天，然后在当晚返回，

sentences.en: where she made that fake, frantic, triple-O call.
sentences.zh: 拨打了那个虚假的、慌乱的紧急求救电话。

sentences.en: Police and emergency services.
sentences.zh: 警察和紧急救援服务。

sentences.en: Listen to me.
sentences.zh: 听我说。

sentences.en: Is there blood everywhere?
sentences.zh: 到处都是血吗？

sentences.en: Conscious and bleeding.
sentences.zh: 有意识，还在流血。

sentences.en: So now it was the word of two drug-addicted petty criminals against the word of an upmarket, boutique shop owner.
sentences.zh: 所以现在变成了两个吸毒的小罪犯的一面之词，对抗一个高档精品店女老板的一面之词。

sentences.en: Shirley continued to deny she had any involvement in Peter's deaths.
sentences.zh: 雪莉坚决否认自己与彼得的死有任何牵连。

sentences.en: So police arranged for Victor the hitman to pay her another visit and they struck gold.
sentences.zh: 于是警方安排杀手维克托再去拜访她，结果他们大获成功。

sentences.en: The undercover police officer expertly got Shirley to confess her involvement in Peter's murder.
sentences.zh: 卧底警员巧妙地让雪莉承认了她参与谋杀彼得的事实。

sentences.en: Shirley was arrested soon after.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，雪莉被捕。

sentences.en: I put it to you that you were in fact involved in the planning and execution of a plan that resulted in Peter Schillardt's death.
sentences.zh: 我向你指出，你实际上参与谋划并实施了一个导致彼得·希拉尔特死亡的计划。

sentences.en: What do you say to that?
sentences.zh: 对此你有什么要说的？

sentences.en: I have no point to me.
sentences.zh: 我无可奉告。

sentences.en: Shirley refused to say anything to detectives.
sentences.zh: 雪莉拒绝向侦探透露任何信息。

sentences.en: So Shirley Withers ordered a hit on Sophia and Stanley so they wouldn't talk and implicate her in the murder.
sentences.zh: 所以雪莉·威瑟斯花钱买凶要除掉索菲亚和斯坦利，这样他们就不会开口并把她卷入谋杀案中。

sentences.en: Which is kind of ironic because they didn't start talking until they found out
sentences.zh: 这有点讽刺，因为他们直到发现

sentences.en: Shirley had put a hit out on them.
sentences.zh: 雪莉花钱买凶要杀他们时才开始开口交代。

sentences.en: Although to be fair it was still early days and it's doubtful they would have continued to stay silent about Shirley's involvement.
sentences.zh: 尽管公平地说当时还处于早期阶段，他们是否会继续对雪莉的卷入保持沉默也很难说。

sentences.en: They probably would have started to look for a deal at some stage.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在某个阶段会开始寻求认罪协商。

sentences.en: Sophia and Stanley both pled guilty to manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 索菲亚和斯坦利对过失杀人罪名均表示认罪。

sentences.en: In exchange for testifying against Shirley they were both given reduced sentences of six years jail with a non-parole period of three and a half years.
sentences.zh: 作为指控雪莉的交换条件，两人均获得减刑，被判处六年监禁，其中三年半为不得假释期。

sentences.en: Shirley pled guilty to hiring a hitman conspiring to kill Sophia and Stanley but pled not guilty to the murder of Peter.
sentences.zh: 雪莉承认雇凶谋杀及阴谋杀害索菲亚和斯坦利的罪名，但否认谋杀彼得。

sentences.en: After a six week trial
sentences.zh: 经过为期六周的审判后，

sentences.en: Shirley was found guilty of murder and sentenced to 26 years in jail with a non-parole period of 18 years.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被判谋杀罪名成立，判处26年监禁，其中18年为不得假释期。

sentences.en: But Shirley thought she could do better so she appealed this sentence.
sentences.zh: 但雪莉觉得自己还能争取更好的结果，于是她对这一判决提起了上诉。

sentences.en: She argued that it was never her intention to kill Peter and that she had merely wanted to teach him a lesson.
sentences.zh: 她辩称自己从未有过杀害彼得的意图，只是想给他一个教训。

sentences.en: She argued she had no way of knowing how much heroin would kill Peter.
sentences.zh: 她辩称自己根本无从知晓多少剂量的海洛因会致彼得于死地。

sentences.en: Despite the brutal and premeditated nature of the attack the staging of the crime scene her attempts to have the people she hired for the job killed so they couldn't talk
sentences.zh: 尽管袭击手段残酷且经过预谋，伪造犯罪现场，并企图杀死自己雇来行凶的人以让他们无法开口，

sentences.en: she managed to convince the appeal judges and have her charge downgraded from murder to manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 她还是设法说服了上诉法官，将她的罪名从谋杀降为过失杀人。

sentences.en: Here's what one of the judges had to say.
sentences.zh: 以下其中一位法官的发言。

sentences.en: The evidence fell short in our view of establishing an intention to kill or cause serious injury.
sentences.zh: 在我们看来，现有证据不足以证明其具有杀人或造成严重伤害的意图。

sentences.en: Even though in the weeks leading up to Peter's death
sentences.zh: 尽管在彼得去世前的几周里，

sentences.en: Shirley had written a new will that she intended to get Peter to sign.
sentences.zh: 雪莉已经写好了一份新遗嘱，并打算让彼得签署。

sentences.en: The new will still left $1 each to Peter's ex-wives but left the remainder of his estate to Shirley.
sentences.zh: 新遗嘱仍然给彼得的前妻们每人留下一美元，但将他其余的遗产全部留给了雪莉。

sentences.en: For her role in the brutal murder of Peter Shellard
sentences.zh: 鉴于她在残酷谋杀彼得·谢拉德的事件中所扮演的角色，

sentences.en: Shirley Withers was sentenced to 13 years jail with a non-parole period of just 9 years.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·威瑟斯被判处13年监禁，其中仅9年为不得假释期。

sentences.en: She is eligible for release this year.
sentences.zh: 她今年即可获得假释出狱的资格。
